headline: Weathered Expanse and Linn Mercy Flare as Berm Rages On
war_summary: Since the last wire the pace has quickened again, with Palantine Berm rising to nine changes in two hours and fifty-three in the day around Vendett and Windburn Landing, now counted at two Warden and five Colonial posts. Weathered Expanse and Linn Mercy have broken their two-hour silence with eight changes apiece to reach forty-nine and thirty-six in the day at Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, Outwich Ranch and Lathair, the former holding six Warden posts with three neutral and the latter nine Colonial with two neutral. Stonecradle eases to one change in two hours but twenty-one in the day at The Dais and The Reach, now two Warden and seven Colonial, while Stlican Shelf shows nothing in two hours after five in six around Breaker Town. Marban Hollow, Gutter, Farranac Coast and Nevish Line remain quiet in the last two hours despite twenty-nine, eleven, five and eight changes in the day, and Godcrofts logs two fresh entries at Isawa. Heavy losses without recent flips continue in Nevish Line, Callahan's Passage, Deadlands and Mooring County.
